name: skillforge
description: A skill collection for AI-assisted development: one /dev entry point, a deterministic Go quality gate, and a language-agnostic iteration ledger. Every workflow skill ships a script that returns an exit code, so verdicts come from a process instead of the model's self-report.

description_i18n.en: A skill collection for AI-assisted development: one /dev entry point, a deterministic Go quality gate, and a language-agnostic iteration ledger.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 AI 辅助开发的技能集：单一 /dev 入口、确定性的 Go 质量门禁、与语言无关的迭代账本，共 21 个技能。
